blocks.text: PART XXIII - How the Sacred Alphabet Becomes Bondage
blocks.directed: PART XXIII - How the Sacred Alphabet Becomes Bondage

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: *Abhinavagupta takes the very same phonemes that express Bhairava's supreme freedom and explains how they can become the instruments of ignorance. Sāṃkhya arrives carrying fifty classifications, the human mind turns out to be a magnificent factory for mistaking things, Kṣemarāja's beloved Spanda tradition reveals why thought is inseparable from the power of speech, and the Pūrvaśāstra describes the Supreme Lord producing ordinary audible letters from their divine prototypes.*
blocks.directed: *Abhinavagupta takes the very same phonemes that express Bhairava's supreme freedom and explains how they can become the instruments of ignorance. blocks.text: Now here's the philosophical insight I want to retain.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: We began with the pure Mātṛkā.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The divine Mother of phonemic manifestation.
blocks.directed: The divine Mother of phonemic manifestation.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: Her powers expressed the uncontracted freedom of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Her powers expressed the uncontracted freedom of consciousness.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: Then the same phonemes entered the manifestation of cognitive dispositions.
blocks.directed: Then the same phonemes entered the manifestation of cognitive dispositions.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: And those dispositions became involved in limitation.
blocks.directed: And those dispositions became involved in limitation.

blocks.text: The finite subject apprehended the world through increasingly specific structures.
blocks.directed: The finite subject apprehended the world through increasingly specific structures.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: And those structures could conceal their conscious ground.
blocks.directed: And those structures could conceal their conscious ground.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: Now the crucial point is this:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now the crucial point is this:

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: **The phonemic powers did not become independently existing evil substances.**
blocks.directed: **The phonemic powers did not become independently existing evil substances.**

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: Their ultimate nature was never outside consciousness.
blocks.directed: Their ultimate nature was never outside consciousness.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The concealment belongs to the mode of manifestation and recognition.
blocks.directed: The concealment belongs to the mode of manifestation and recognition.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: That's why the *Spandakārikā* says that the powers arise to cover the subject's own nature.
blocks.directed: That's why the *Spandakārikā* says that the powers arise to cover the subject's own nature.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: And why it associates determinate cognition with the penetration of speech.
blocks.directed: And why it associates determinate cognition with the penetration of speech.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The very power that articulates the world can also reinforce the limited subject's identification with it.
blocks.directed: The very power that articulates the world can also reinforce the limited subject's identification with it.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: But the same power can serve recognition.
blocks.directed: But the same power can serve recognition.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: That's why Abhinavagupta is able to use Sanskrit commentary as a means of philosophical disclosure.
blocks.directed: That's why Abhinavagupta is able to use Sanskrit commentary as a means of philosophical disclosure.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: He isn't attempting to abolish all language.
blocks.directed: He isn't attempting to abolish all language.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: He is investigating its ultimate ground.
blocks.directed: He is investigating its ultimate ground.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: And the *Pūrvaśāstra* makes the relationship visible through the generation of Māyic phonemes corresponding to their pure prototypes.
blocks.directed: And the *Pūrvaśāstra* makes the relationship visible through the generation of Māyic phonemes corresponding to their pure prototypes.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The audible letters are different in mode.
blocks.directed: The audible letters are different in mode.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The same ordinary word can be implicated in very different modes of understanding.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The sacred alphabet is not simply a collection of sounds that automatically confer realization.
blocks.directed: The sacred alphabet is not simply a collection of sounds that automatically confer realization.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: Its deepest meaning belongs to the recognition of the conscious power through which all sounds become manifest.
blocks.directed: Its deepest meaning belongs to the recognition of the conscious power through which all sounds become manifest.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: **Bondage is not the destruction of consciousness. It is the failure to recognize the fullness of consciousness within the very powers through which experience appears.**
blocks.directed: **Bondage is not the destruction of consciousness. It is the failure to recognize the fullness of consciousness within the very powers through which experience appears.**

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: And that is why liberation remains possible.
blocks.directed: And that is why liberation remains possible.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The source has never been fundamentally lost.
blocks.directed: The source has never been fundamentally lost.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The phonemes remain expressions of Śakti.
blocks.directed: The phonemes remain expressions of Śakti.

blocks.text: Having pure awareness as her nature.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: The mind may construct a thousand identities.

blocks.text: The words may become entangled in misunderstanding.

blocks.text: The cognitive dispositions may become bonds.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: But the conscious ground has not become a second, independently ignorant Absolute.
blocks.directed: But the conscious ground has not become a second, independently ignorant Absolute.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: Its own freedom includes the possibility of recognition.
blocks.directed: Its own freedom includes the possibility of recognition.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: And that's where Abhinavagupta now turns.
blocks.directed: And that's where Abhinavagupta now turns.

blocks.section: 24. The final insight - The alphabet never ceased to be divi
blocks.text: From the mechanism of bondage to a beautiful synthesis of the supreme conscious reality.
blocks.directed: From the mechanism of bondage to a beautiful synthesis of the supreme conscious reality.
